pet_notes: Official original Robo-Nene/NeneRobo from Project SEKAI, a compact rigid humanoid stage robot modeled after Kusanagi Nene. Preserve original mascot proportions: huge broad head, short stout body, grey-sage long segmented hair with two thick low sidelocks and pink round ties, lavender circular eyes, subtle vertical cheek panel seams, green headband, angular pale lime butterfly hair ornament with pink double outline on screen-right, pink striped neck bow, teal sleeveless vest with pale yellow piping and three yellow buttons over pale cream short sleeves with pink cuffs, flared skirt alternating pale yellow and cream panels with lavender hem, short pale yellow legs/boot shafts with black bow detail, dark teal rounded shoes. Small lavender balls at skirt sides remain attached by short solid rods, never floating. Arms short and simple, hands mitten-like. No school uniform. Natural printed robot eyes and rigid head pitch/yaw, no whole-sprite rotation.
style_notes: Close to the original Japanese mobile game robot illustration and official box art: clean thin dark outlines, crisp restrained cel shading, flat pastel colors, iconic 2-head-tall mascot geometry, slightly deadpan cute robot face; 2D game sprite, not photorealistic plastic, not generic human chibi, not pixel art.
